name: circle-carousel-3
title: U-shaped carousel
description: Covers are filed into a U and sit askew, like prints that have been handled.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many covers are in the pile.

props.name: width
props.doc: Width of the U, centre to centre of its arms, in px.

props.name: armHeight
props.doc: Length of each straight arm above the curve, in px.

props.name: minSize
props.doc: Side of the cover at the top of the left arm, in px.

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: Side of the cover at the top of the right arm, in px.

props.name: scatter
props.doc: How far covers sit off the path, in px, so they pile.

props.name: lean
props.doc: How far covers are turned from square, in degrees.

props.name: travel
props.doc: How far the covers move along the U over the shot, as a fraction of its length.

props.name: travelStart
props.doc: Frame the covers start moving.

props.name: travelFrames
props.doc: Frames the move takes, eased in and out.

props.name: seed
props.doc: Seed for the scatter and lean. Same seed, same pile.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one cover appearing and the next.

props.name: rideZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the opening shot on the smallest covers.

props.name: push
props.doc: How far the camera pushes into the largest cover at the end.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: title
props.doc: Small title at the top left. Empty for none.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Smaller line under the title. Empty for none.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the label.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Title.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Caption.
